answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.point: PJM suggests FERC may defer the contested issues until its November compliance filing.
answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.quote: it may be appropriate for the Commission to defer consideration of these issues until it has the benefit of a complete record following next month’s compliance filing.

answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.point: PJM expects systems to accept requests for the new services in September 2027, after the changes needed for Interim NITS.
answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.quote: PJM anticipates modifying the systems needed to begin accepting requests for the new transmission services in September of 2027.

answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.point: PJM is designing a unified cluster study of large loads and generation, to be filed on or before November 16, 2026 in response to E-7.
answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.quote: PJM is developing a proposal for a new a study process that would evaluate large loads and generation interconnection requests together in a unified cluster study that would take roughly a year to complete.

answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.point: PJM gives a timeline running from a 2027 application window to service in the first quarter of 2029.
answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.quote: application process in September of 2027, conducting the study in 2028, and beginning to provide service in first quarter 2029.

answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.point: PJM says it will not repeat Necessary Studies already done, though changed scope can trigger more study.
answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.quote: While PJM will not repeat studies already performed, project scope or other technical changes may trigger the need for additional study.

answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.point: PJM answers Constellation that Interim NITS will be interruptible and curtailed before capacity-backed services.
answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.quote: Interim NITS will be interruptible and curtailed before firm services like Firm Contract Demand Service or NITS that are capacity-backed services.

answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.point: PJM will clarify in November that load with behind-the-meter generation is excluded from the Co-Located Load definition.
answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.quote: PJM intends to propose clarifications to the definition of BTMG in the November compliance filing to specify that load with BTMG is excluded from the definition of Co-Located Load.

answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.point: PJM does not object to AMP's proposed fix to the Eligible Generating Facility definition.
answer-el25-49-pjm-limited-protests.quote: PJM, does not object to AMP’s proposed revision to Eligible Generating Facility definition set forth in its pleading.

compliance-er26-1479-pjm.point: PJM files under FPA section 206 to comply with the June 18 order and plans a full section 205 large load filing by mid-November.
compliance-er26-1479-pjm.quote: PJM intends to submit that filing by mid-November 2026.

compliance-er26-1479-pjm.point: PJM sets October 17, 2026 for most revisions and July 1, 2028 for Interim NITS so it can build tools to curtail non-firm service.
compliance-er26-1479-pjm.quote: PJM proposes an effective date of July 1, 2028, to provide time for operational changes and implementation of additional operational tools

compliance-er26-1479-pjm.point: PJM adds an Eligible Load definition covering co-located load and load behind BTMG, so both can take Interim NITS.
compliance-er26-1479-pjm.quote: Eligible Load shall mean Co-Located Load or load connected to Behind the Meter Generation.

compliance-er26-1479-pjm.point: PJM removes the 50 MW nameplate limit from the Retail BTMG definition, as the June order directed, and works on the 50 MW netting materiality threshold separately.
compliance-er26-1479-pjm.quote: eliminates the rejected 50 MW nameplate limit and other netting exemptions

compliance-er26-1479-pjm.point: Customers must pass the Necessary Study process and finish upgrades before serving co-located load, from existing or new generators.
compliance-er26-1479-pjm.quote: not begin serving Eligible Load until the entire scope of the work under their GIA as amended after the Necessary Study process is complete.

compliance-er26-1479-pjm.point: Customers with existing service agreements can modify them through the Necessary Study process rather than sign a new GIA.
compliance-er26-1479-pjm.quote: PJM is proposing changes to allow customers that obtained service agreements pursuant to Parts VI and VII to modify those agreements

compliance-er26-1479-pjm.point: Interim NITS is energy-only and non-firm, converts to NITS once upgrades are done, and is suspended for up to 120 days after a first dispatch failure.
compliance-er26-1479-pjm.quote: suspend service for up to 120 days after the first instance and terminate service after the second.

compliance-er26-1479-pjm.point: PJM defers Firm and Non-Firm Contract Demand services and some BTMG netting to a later compliance filing under a 90-day extension.
compliance-er26-1479-pjm.quote: PJM sought a 90-day extension of certain directives in the June Order.

compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.point: The filing implements the rate for Interim Network Integration Transmission Service ordered on June 18.
compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.quote: the PJM Transmission Owners are submitting new and revised tariff records to the PJM Open Access Transmission Tariff

compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.point: The three new services are Interim NITS, firm contract demand and non-firm contract demand transmission service.
compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.quote: The new transmission services are: Interim NITS, firm contract demand transmission service, and non-firm contract demand transmission service.

compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.point: FERC granted a 90-day extension to November 16, 2026, but PJM committed to file Interim NITS provisions on August 17.
compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.quote: Notwithstanding its request for extension, PJM committed to submit a compliance filing on August 17, 2026, addressing several compliance directives, including those related to Interim NITS.

compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.point: New Part XI sections 706 and 706.1 set the Interim NITS rate, with two new definitions.
compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.quote: New Sections 706 and 706.1 specify the Interim NITS rate.

compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.point: The owners request a July 1, 2028 effective date.
compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.quote: The PJM Transmission Owners request that the revisions submitted with this partial compliance filing become effective on July 1, 2028.

compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.point: They note the directives are under challenge and the tariff sheets may face a termination filing.
compliance-er26-3537-pjm-tos.quote: the tendered tariff sheet revisions herein may be subject to a subsequent termination filing.

eot-el25-49-pjm.point: PJM and the Indicated TOs each moved on July 28, 2026 for 90 more days to comply with the co-location order.
eot-el25-49-pjm.quote: On July 28, 2026, PJM filed a motion for a 90-day extension of time to comply with certain directives in the Commission’s June 18, 2026 order in this proceeding,

eot-el25-49-pjm.point: The Indicated TOs say the compliance issues overlap significantly with their show cause order work.
eot-el25-49-pjm.quote: the issues that PJM and Indicated TOs must address on compliance significantly overlap with the issues PJM and Indicated TOs are addressing in response to the Large Load Show Cause Order.

eot-el25-49-pjm.point: Constellation supported the motion but said PJM must still file complete Interim NITS provisions on August 17, 2026.
eot-el25-49-pjm.quote: filed an answer supporting PJM’s motion but with the clarification that PJM remains obligated to file, on August 17, 2026, a complete set of provisions to facilitate Interim NITS.

eot-el25-49-pjm.point: FERC grants the extension to November 16, 2026 for PJM and the PJM transmission owners.
eot-el25-49-pjm.quote: Upon consideration, notice is hereby given that an extension of 90 days is granted.
